events.heading: Events We Play

cards.label: Birthdays
cards.copy: Make your birthday celebration one to remember with live music, great energy, and songs everyone can enjoy. We bring the party to life and keep your guests singing, dancing, and having a great time.

cards.label: Weddings
cards.copy: From the ceremony to the reception, we provide live music that sets the perfect mood for your special day. We’ll help create unforgettable moments and keep the dance floor moving all night long.

cards.label: Quinceañeras
cards.copy: Make your quinceañera unforgettable with live Norteño entertainment that keeps family and friends dancing all night. We provide the perfect soundtrack for this once-in-a-lifetime celebration.

cards.label: Anniversaries
cards.copy: Honor your anniversary with live Norteño music that creates a warm and festive atmosphere. Whether it’s an intimate gathering or a large celebration, we’ll make the occasion memorable.

cards.label: Baby Showers
cards.copy: Celebrate your growing family with live Norteño music that adds warmth and joy to your baby shower. We create a fun, family-friendly atmosphere everyone can enjoy.

cards.label: Graduations
cards.copy: Celebrate your graduation with live Norteño music that marks this important milestone in style. Our band brings the perfect entertainment for family and friends to enjoy together.

cards.label: Communions
cards.copy: Celebrate a First Communion with live Norteño music that brings loved ones together after the ceremony. Our performances create a welcoming and festive atmosphere for guests of all ages.

cards.label: Baptisms
cards.copy: Make your baptism celebration even more meaningful with live Norteño music for your family gathering. We provide music that complements this joyful and memorable occasion.

cards.label: Divorces
cards.copy: Turn a new chapter into a celebration with live Norteño music that keeps the party fun and upbeat. Gather your friends and enjoy an unforgettable night of great music and dancing.

events.cta: We play live music for weddings, birthdays, private parties, and all kinds of celebrations. Even if your event isn’t listed above, there’s a good chance we can be part of it. Get in touch and let us know what you’re planning.

cards.heading: 20+ Years of Experience
cards.copy: For more than two decades, we have provided live norteño music for weddings, quinceañeras, birthdays, private parties, corporate events, and family celebrations throughout Southern California. Our years of experience allow us to adapt to every venue, audience, and event, delivering a polished performance that helps make your celebration memorable from beginning to end.

cards.heading: Professional & Reliable
cards.copy: Planning an event comes with enough stress. You shouldn’t have to worry about your entertainment. From your first inquiry through the final performance, we pride ourselves on clear communication, punctual arrival, professional presentation, and dependable service. We work closely with every client to ensure your event runs smoothly and your guests enjoy an unforgettable experience.

cards.heading: Authentic Live Norteño Music
cards.copy: Our goal is simple: create an atmosphere that brings people together. Whether your guests want to dance, sing along, or simply enjoy authentic live music, we tailor every performance to the energy of your celebration. Combining traditional norteño favorites with modern hits, we perform music that connects with audiences of all ages.

cards.heading: Perfect for Every Celebration
cards.copy: Every event is unique, and every performance should be too. Whether you’re hosting an intimate backyard gathering, a large wedding reception, a quinceañera, a birthday party, or a corporate celebration, we adapt our performance to fit your venue, schedule, and guests. No matter the occasion, we’re committed to providing entertainment that keeps the celebration going.

questions.question: How many members are in the band?
questions.answer: We have five members: a lead singer, guitarist, bassist, drummer, and accordion player.

questions.question: Do you provide your own sound system?
questions.answer: Yes. We bring a high-quality, well-balanced sound system that’s professionally tuned to ensure great sound throughout your event.

questions.question: How Much do you charge?
questions.answer: Our rates typically range from $550–$750 per hour, depending on the event location and travel distance. Contact us for a personalized quote, we’re happy to discuss your event and provide accurate pricing.

questions.question: Is there a minimum?
questions.answer: Yes. We require a 3-hour minimum for all bookings. To reserve your date, a deposit equal to the first hour’s performance is required.

questions.question: Do you travel for events?
questions.answer: Absolutely! We perform throughout the Greater Los Angeles area and across Southern California. Travel fees may apply for events outside our local service area.

questions.question: What type of music do you play?/Do you play a variety?
questions.answer: We specialize in Norteño music, but we’re a versatile band capable of learning and performing almost any song. Our repertoire includes cumbias, huapangos, románticas, corridos, and many other regional Mexican styles. If there’s a special song you’d like to hear, let us know, we’re happy to make it part of your event.

questions.question: Do you take song requests?
questions.answer: Yes! We can learn up to five songs in advance for your event. During the performance, we’re also happy to take requests. We have an extensive catalog of music, but because every event is different, we can’t guarantee that we’ll know or be able to perform every requested song.

questions.question: Do you play music during the break?
questions.answer: Yes. We can provide background music during our breaks for an additional $100. The fee covers the extra equipment, setup, and sound configuration needed to keep the music playing seamlessly throughout your event.

questions.question: How far in advance should I book?
questions.answer: We recommend booking as early as possible, especially for weekends and holidays, as dates fill up quickly.

questions.question: How do I book the band?
questions.answer: Booking is easy! Simply fill out the contact form on our website or give us a call with your event details, including the date, location, and type of event. Once we confirm our availability, a deposit secures your booking.

questions.question: How long are you performance sets?
questions.answer: We perform throughout your booked time with short breaks in between sets.

questions.question: Can you perform outdoors?
questions.answer: Yes, as long as there is adequate space, access to power, and protection from the weather.

questions.question: What do you need from the venue?
questions.answer: We ask for a safe, level performance area, access to electrical outlets for our sound equipment, and a dedicated parking space close to the performance area. This helps us safely transport and set up our instruments and sound equipment efficiently.

questions.question: Can you accomodate special announcements or dedications?
questions.answer: Yes! We would be happy to help make your event more memorable with special announcements or dedications when arranged in advance.
